name: B10-0065/2025 (The Left) – Case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It asks the Democratic Republic of the Congo to move Jean-Jacques Wondo's case from a military court to a civilian one, and to restore the pause on the death penalty. It also asks Rwanda to pull its soldiers out of the Congo and asks the European Union and its member states to stop cooperating with and funding the Rwandan army.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- The requests concern the Congo's courts, the death penalty, and Rwanda's army.
- Parliament sends the text to the EU Council, Commission and others; no deadline is set.
